proposed.explanation: A vocational diploma is insufficient. SPP 204-A requires a professional degree. Correct. A CSG inspector must hold a Bachelor of Science in Architecture (BS Arch) degree, ensuring professional competence in architectural supervision. A master's degree is not required. The minimum is a BS Arch degree. An engineering degree does not substitute for the BS Arch requirement for CSG inspectors under SPP 204-A. SPP 204-A requires CSG inspectors to hold a BS Architecture degree as a minimum qualification. This ensures inspectors have the architectural knowledge needed to verify that construction faithfully executes the architect's design intent. CSG inspector minimum qualification = BS Arch degree.
